# Independent audit: selected critical-star cover escape

**PASS.** I independently checked every section of
candidate 9b703b460ed5bf2b, its
physical-simplex derivative dependency, and the actual binary-isolation
construction. No mathematical repair is needed.

## Exact mixed accounting

The moving threshold must be retained at both endpoints. On the
unchanged reflected endpoint the cap has volume \(V-F_i(I,a)\), while
the unchanged middle contributes \(U/2\). Therefore, even when \(a\)
varies,
\[
 \mu_W(H_i(a))=D+F_i(W,a)-F_i(I,a).
\]
The subtraction is essential: differentiating only the moved endpoint
would give an incorrect global budget. The source note uses the exact
identity throughout. Concurrence \(\sum_i a_i=1\) makes the sum of all
selected ambient margins zero, so coverage survives the whole path.

The initial centrally symmetric source has actual absolute maximum
\(D\): all nonvertical through-origin caps have boundary-null mass
\(M/2\), vertical containing caps have at least that mass, and an
opposite nonvertical pair gives the global upper bound. These arguments
include all candidates and closed caps.

## Physical feasibility and first order

In barycentric direction coordinates, \(K-K\) is precisely
\(\{y:\sum y_i=0,\ \sum(y_i)_+\le1\}\). For a zero-sum column
perturbation \(\delta\), its positive coordinate sum is
\(\|\delta\|_1/2\). Thus the displayed bound
\[
 \sum_i ((We_j-e_k)/2)_+
 \le \tfrac12+\tfrac14\|We_j-e_j\|_1<1
\]
is correct, also when \(j=k\). The finite vertex-pair hull is compactly
inside \(K-K\). This proves the exact three integer fibers after
perturbation, rather than only a necessary midpoint condition.

The determinant/cap formula has positive denominators on one common
neighborhood. I checked the derivative right inverse \(S_a\), the
coefficient \(J_{ij}=a_j+(a_i-1)/d\), and the signs
\[
 \operatorname{tr}A=J/2,\qquad
 D_W(F_i/V)(I,a)[A]=-\epsilon.
\]
Nonuniform concurrent thresholds have a nonzero \(J_{ij}\) for
\(d\ge2\). The strict first-order gain and all cap decreases therefore
hold on a common positive time interval.

## Canonical cubic path

For \(a(t)=m^{-1}{\bf1}+t(e_1-e_0)\), the fixed choice \((i,j)=(0,1)\)
gives \(J_{01}=(d-1)t/d\). The construction with this fixed sign is
analytic through \(t=0\), even though \(J_{01}(0)=0\).
At the canonical point \(h_i=m\Gamma_d\) and
\(H(0)=1/\Gamma_d\). With \(W(t)=I+t^2A(a(t))\),
\[
 \det W(t)=1+\frac{d-1}{2d}t^3+O(t^4).
\]
For completeness, the uniform remainder in the cap calculation follows
by Taylor expansion in \(W\) on a compact joint neighborhood of
\((I,m^{-1}{\bf1})\):
\[
 \frac{F_i(I+t^2A(a(t)),a(t))-F_i(I,a(t))}{V}
 =-t^2\epsilon(a(t))+O(t^4).
\]
All relevant rational cap formulas are analytic there, \(A(a(t))\)
is bounded, and the finite number of caps allows a common remainder
bound. Since
\(\epsilon(a(t))=\Gamma_d(d-1)t/(2d)+O(t^2)\), the claimed strict
cubic cap decrease follows. In particular, no uncontrolled
threshold-only term remains. The path enters every joint neighborhood;
the excluded dimension-one case is correctly identified.

## Binary extension and scope

Conditioning a convex combination on a binary coordinate vector forces
all its terms to have that vector. Hence the three star fibers and the
two fibers at each other binary vector are exactly the integer fibers.
The regular-base exposing functional has gap at least one: changing a
binary vector loses at least three, while the remaining integer
coordinate gains at most two.

All isolating tilts can be chosen finite with strict exclusion. Once
chosen, the same tilts work in a sufficiently small joint neighborhood.
The regular groups keep exact mass \(D\); the selected star group
strictly decreases. Their own-fiber covers retain full source coverage,
and the unique-vertex neighborhoods prove inclusion-minimality, not
minimum cardinality. An unchanged regular simplex centroid supplies
absolute depth at least \(D\), so the binary example has maximum exactly
\(D\) while its total mass grows.

This proves escape only for the retained cover. It does not preserve
the discarded variance groups, assert arbitrary cover compression, or
prove a general joint-stationarity or OC theorem. Global section
cancellation for a fixed symmetric body is consistent with this result:
the endpoint body also moves here.

## Verification

Reran successfully:

- python3 supporting computation verify_selected_one_group_critical_star_escape.py:
  22 exact derivative/series/compatible-path checks and 168 actual
  planar isolated cap budgets.
- work/math-venv/bin/python
  supporting computation verify_simplex_fixed_cap_first_order_rigidity.py:
  816 exact derivative, right-inverse, and stationarity checks.

The all-dimensional conclusion is supplied by the analytic proof,
not extrapolated from the finite verifier dimensions.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
